other_conditions: Beneficiary must be working in an establishment registered under the Punjab Labour Welfare Fund Act, 1965
Beneficiary must have regular contributions to the labour welfare fund received by the Board
Beneficiary must not be a defaulter under any earlier loan from the Board
Beneficiary must have a standing guarantee from the employer
Beneficiary must be a member of the Board for at least six months before applying
Loan can be taken for only one item at a time
benefits_summary: Interest‑free loan up to ₹25,000 for purchase of items such as motorcycle/scooter, fridge, TV/LCD, cooler, fan or bicycle, repayable in equal monthly installments.
documents_required: Clear picture of both sides of the Aadhaar card
Clear picture of the Bank Passbook
Clear picture of all pages of the BOCW copy issued by the Board
